spots.name: The Cold Spot (Vielva 2004)
spots.note: Official WMAP detection at SMHW scale R8=4.17°. IDCM node 0.

spots.name: Planck gp10 cold spot

not_found: Cruz 2005 "~10+ cold spots catalogue" — NO such table exists. Cruz 2005 (astro-ph/0405341) is a Gaussianity study; Table 4 lists only sub-spots of the single Cold Spot.
Cruz 2007 (astro-ph/0603859) — same single Cold Spot, no catalogue.
Hou 2009 (0903.4446) — statistical study of hot/cold spot populations, no coordinate catalogue.
Vielva 2007 hot spot catalogue — mis-remembered; Planck 2013/2015 mention an anomalous HOT area (see O2: F6=277.6μK at (157.8°,-70.3°), confirmed).
Gurzadyan 2007 cold spot statistics — arXiv search shows no such catalogue; Gurzadyan 2014 (1404.6347) re-analyzes the SAME Cold Spot.
